provenance.nameVerification: Every display name is copied verbatim from a GeoNames alternate-name record whose isolanguage is zh or zh-*. Historic names are excluded. Untagged Han aliases only prefilter candidates; they never become final names.
provenance.geospatialVerification: geonameId joins cities500 coordinates/population to country-scoped alternate-name records. Continent is the GeoNames countryInfo country classification, not a coordinate/polygon inference.
limitations: GeoNames is community data supplied as-is; language tags and population figures may contain errors or be stale. A zh tag is source evidence, not an authoritative official Chinese transliteration standard.
cities500 includes populated places and administrative seats, not a legal definition of city.
No Wikidata verification was used: its SPARQL endpoint was unreachable here. No manual translation or inferred language fallback.

sampling.method: SHA256(seed, stratum, geonameId) priority sampling without replacement. 32 positive-population places below 50,000, then 28 continent supplements; six continents have ten samples each.
sampling.languageScope: Chinese only, including source-attested overseas Chinese names; no multilingual-language capability claim.
sampling.eligibility: PPL/PPLA/PPLA1-4/PPLC; positive recorded population, valid WGS84 coordinates; Han-only name candidate in cities500 and a current zh/zh-* alternate-name record.
sampling.selectionBias: Not uniform over all world cities or countries. Geography quotas, the positive-population cities500 subset, and availability of source-tagged Chinese/Han names condition the pool. Population <50,000 is a cold-place proxy, not measured familiarity.
sampling.liveSelectionMethod: Selected before any grounding/model test: seed-ranked one low-population city per inhabited continent plus two seed-ranked extra low-population cities. Eight IDs are fixed for 4-model / 32-call evidence.
